versions.content: Crypto_CustomService returns the actual error value of the KeyM service If Crypto_ProcessJob() is called for a job configured with service CUSTOM_SERVICE and if CRYPTO_E_CUSTOM_ERROR will be re- turned then secondaryOutputPtr shall contain the appropriate return value from Crypto_KeyM_ReturnType data type.
